history.summary: IDENTITY FLAG: no shrine named exactly 'Bhatli Thakurani Temple' has any web footprint; 'Thakurani' is the western-Odisha epithet for the village goddess. The best-supported referent is the Samleswari Mandir at Bhatli town (mapped place listing at 21.457311, 83.535842; onefivenine lists 'Samleswari mandir, Bhatli 768030' among the town's temples, alongside Dadhibaman, Shiva and Shyam temples) - treat this identification as provisional. Bhatli is a historic temple town in Bargarh district: it hosts the famous Baba Shyam (Shyam Bihari) temple on the Gandhamardhan foothills and the Jagannath temple at nearby Kuisira, and a Bhatli stone inscription records the Chauhan-era history of the region. No documented history, patron or festival calendar was found for the Bhatli Thakurani/Samleswari shrine itself - all such details need on-ground verification. Not to be confused with Bhatli Shyam Mandir or with the Maa Budhi Thakurani temples of Berhampur/Angul.
